primary_success_criterion.definition: The parsed Morse graph has exactly two nodes whose Conley-index tuple has a nonzero homological degree-0 component. All Morse nodes are counted, not only graph sinks; higher-degree components do not disqualify a node, so both (x-1, x-1, 0) and (x^p-1, 0, 0) qualify as one stable-index node.
primary_success_criterion.name: exactly_two_nonzero_degree0_nodes

success_criterion.definition: The parsed Morse graph has exactly two graph sinks, and the Conley-index tuple on each sink is exactly (x^4-1, 0, 0): x^4-1 in homological degree 0 and zero in the other saved degrees.
success_criterion.name: exact_two_period4_sink_indices
